name: KnowledgeOwl
description: KnowledgeOwl is knowledge base software for creating, organizing, and sharing internal and customer-facing documentation, built for teams replacing fragmented tools like Confluence, SharePoint, and scattered documents.
best_for: Positioned for healthcare, education, IT services, manufacturing, credit unions, call centers, insurance, and financial services organizations, including compliance-focused teams such as government agencies and credit unions.
features: Unlimited nested categories with drag-and-drop reorganization
Built-in table of contents and full-text search
AI-powered chatbot that answers only from the organization's own knowledge base content
Version history for tracking updates to processes and policies
Role-based access control across teams and departments
Built-in analytics on article performance, deflection rates, and search behavior
Custom theme design included with onboarding
